scope: Corrective exercise prescription for FlexiLab AI Screening: posture, shoulder mobility, deep squat, ASLR, and related movement-system priorities.
safety_note: Educational movement-quality support only. Stop and refer to a qualified clinician if pain, neurological symptoms, recent trauma, unexplained weakness, dizziness, numbness, or medical red flags are present.

pain_rule.discomfort: Keep low intensity, use mobility/control only, monitor response.
pain_rule.pain: Do not prescribe progressive/loading exercises for that pattern; provide gentle reset only and referral message.

exercises.name: 90/90 Breathing Feet on Wall
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back with feet on wall, knees bent, breathe slowly through the nose and exhale fully.
exercises.common_errors: Arching lower back; holding breath; pushing hard into the wall.

exercises.name: Crocodile Breathing
exercises.instructions: Lie face down, forehead on hands, breathe into abdomen and ribs without lifting shoulders.
exercises.common_errors: Shrugging shoulders; forcing inhalation; neck tension.

exercises.name: Child's Pose Breathing
exercises.instructions: Sit hips toward heels, arms forward, breathe into upper back and ribs.
exercises.common_errors: Knee pain; forcing shoulders; breath holding.

exercises.name: Foam Roller Thoracic Relaxation
exercises.instructions: Lie with foam roller across upper back, relax and breathe for short intervals.
exercises.common_errors: Rolling on neck; excessive lumbar arch; pain.

exercises.name: Massage Ball Pec Release
exercises.instructions: Place ball between chest and wall, breathe and move slowly around tender areas.
exercises.common_errors: Pressing too hard; numbness or tingling; shoulder pain.

exercises.name: Massage Ball Glute Release
exercises.instructions: Sit on ball over glute area and move gently, avoiding sharp pain.
exercises.common_errors: Rolling on bone; excessive pressure; nerve symptoms.

exercises.name: Calf Foam Roll
exercises.instructions: Roll calf slowly, pausing on tight areas while breathing.
exercises.common_errors: Fast rolling; numbness; excessive pressure.

exercises.name: Lat Foam Roll
exercises.instructions: Lie on side with roller under lat, move slowly and breathe.
exercises.common_errors: Rolling into armpit aggressively; shoulder pinching.

exercises.name: Chin Tuck Supine
exercises.instructions: Lie on back and gently draw chin inward as if making a double chin, then relax.
exercises.common_errors: Lifting head; forcing range; holding breath.

exercises.name: Wall Chin Tuck
exercises.instructions: Stand against wall, gently tuck chin while keeping back of head long.
exercises.common_errors: Tilting head down; rib flare; pushing too hard.

exercises.name: Wall Posture Hold
exercises.instructions: Stand tall against wall, ribs down, chin neutral, breathe calmly.
exercises.common_errors: Overarching lower back; shrugging; holding breath.

exercises.name: Seated Neck Rotation Control
exercises.instructions: Sit tall and rotate head slowly left and right without shoulder movement.
exercises.common_errors: Moving trunk; forcing end range; pain.

exercises.name: Foam Roller Thoracic Extension
exercises.instructions: Place roller under upper back, support head, extend gently over roller and return.
exercises.common_errors: Arching from lower back; pulling neck; pain.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Open Book
exercises.instructions: Lie on side with knees bent, rotate top arm open while knees stay stacked.
exercises.common_errors: Forcing shoulder to floor; knees separating; neck tension.

exercises.name: Quadruped Thread the Needle
exercises.instructions: From quadruped, reach one arm under body then rotate open.
exercises.common_errors: Moving hips excessively; collapsing shoulder; breath holding.

exercises.name: Wall Thoracic Rotation
exercises.instructions: Stand side-on to wall and rotate upper body open while hips remain stable.
exercises.common_errors: Turning pelvis; shrugging; forcing range.

exercises.name: Tall-Kneeling Overhead Reach
exercises.instructions: Tall kneel, ribs down, reach arms overhead without arching.
exercises.common_errors: Rib flare; shoulder shrug; lower-back extension.

exercises.name: Seated Thoracic Extension Chair
exercises.instructions: Sit with upper back against chair edge, support head and gently extend.
exercises.common_errors: Overarching lower back; neck pulling; pain.

exercises.name: Child's Pose Lat Stretch
exercises.instructions: Sit hips back and reach arms forward, breathe into sides of ribs.
exercises.common_errors: Shoulder pinch; forcing range; holding breath.

exercises.name: Wall Slide
exercises.instructions: Forearms on wall, slide upward while ribs stay down and neck relaxed.
exercises.common_errors: Rib flare; shrugging; lower-back arch.

exercises.name: Doorway Pec Stretch
exercises.instructions: Place forearm on doorway and gently turn body away until stretch is mild.
exercises.common_errors: Shoulder pain; overstretching; rib flare.

exercises.name: Posterior Shoulder Stretch
exercises.instructions: Bring arm across chest and gently support with opposite arm.
exercises.common_errors: Neck tension; shoulder pinch; aggressive pulling.

exercises.name: Wall Scapular Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Hands on wall, protract and retract shoulder blades with straight arms.
exercises.common_errors: Shrugging; bending elbows; head forward.

exercises.name: Scapular Push-Up
exercises.instructions: In plank or incline plank, move shoulder blades apart/together without bending elbows.
exercises.common_errors: Elbows bending; hips sagging; neck tension.

exercises.name: Serratus Wall Slide
exercises.instructions: Forearms on wall with light band tension, slide up while pushing gently through forearms.
exercises.common_errors: Rib flare; shrugging; wrist pain.

exercises.name: Band External Rotation
exercises.instructions: Elbow by side, rotate forearm outward with light band tension.
exercises.common_errors: Elbow drifting; trunk rotation; too much resistance.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.instructions: Hold band at chest height, pull apart while ribs stay down and neck relaxed.
exercises.common_errors: Shrugging; lower-back arch; jerky movement.

exercises.name: Prone Y-T-W
exercises.instructions: Lie face down and lift arms in Y, T, W shapes with thumbs up.
exercises.common_errors: Neck extension; shrugging; lifting too high.

exercises.name: Dead Bug Breathing
exercises.instructions: Lie on back, ribs down, slowly move opposite arm/leg while breathing.
exercises.common_errors: Lower-back arch; moving too fast; breath holding.

exercises.name: Dead Bug Heel Taps
exercises.instructions: Lie on back, tap one heel to floor while keeping pelvis quiet.
exercises.common_errors: Arching back; rushing; neck tension.

exercises.name: Bridge March
exercises.instructions: Hold bridge and slowly lift one foot without pelvis dropping.
exercises.common_errors: Pelvis rotating; back arching; hamstring cramp.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.instructions: Lie on back, lift hips by squeezing glutes while ribs stay down.
exercises.common_errors: Overarching back; pushing through toes; hamstring cramp.

exercises.name: Side Plank from Knees
exercises.instructions: Support on elbow and knees, lift hips and hold neutral line.
exercises.common_errors: Shoulder shrug; hips dropping; breath holding.

exercises.name: Bird Dog Regression
exercises.instructions: In quadruped, extend one leg or one arm only while trunk stays quiet.
exercises.common_errors: Rotating pelvis; arching back; rushing.

exercises.name: Full Bird Dog
exercises.instructions: Extend opposite arm and leg while keeping trunk quiet.
exercises.common_errors: Pelvic rotation; low-back arch; neck extension.

exercises.name: Pallof Press Standing
exercises.instructions: Stand side-on to band anchor, press band forward without rotating.
exercises.common_errors: Leaning; twisting; breath holding.

exercises.name: Supine Hamstring Floss
exercises.instructions: Lie on back, hold thigh and gently straighten/bend knee within easy range.
exercises.common_errors: Forcing stretch; lifting pelvis; pain behind knee.

exercises.name: Band-Assisted Leg Lowering
exercises.instructions: Use band to support raised leg, slowly lower opposite leg while pelvis stays still.
exercises.common_errors: Back arching; knee bending; aggressive stretch.

exercises.name: Active Straight-Leg Raise Hold
exercises.instructions: Raise straight leg to controlled height and hold while opposite leg stays long.
exercises.common_errors: Knee bending; pelvis rotating; breath holding.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Lowering with Band
exercises.instructions: Hold one leg with band, lower and raise opposite straight leg under control.
exercises.common_errors: Arching back; losing knee extension; too much range.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Switch
exercises.instructions: Sit in 90/90 position and switch sides with control.
exercises.common_errors: Rounding back; using momentum; knee pain.

exercises.name: Quadruped Rock-Back
exercises.instructions: From hands and knees, rock hips back while spine stays long.
exercises.common_errors: Rounding lower back; forcing range; shoulder pain.

exercises.name: Adductor Rock-Back
exercises.instructions: In quadruped, extend one leg to side and rock hips back gently.
exercises.common_errors: Twisting pelvis; knee discomfort; forcing stretch.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.instructions: Half-kneel, tuck pelvis slightly and shift forward gently.
exercises.common_errors: Arching back; forcing lunge; knee pain.

exercises.name: Hip Hinge with Dowel
exercises.instructions: Hold dowel along spine and hinge at hips while maintaining three contact points.
exercises.common_errors: Rounding back; bending knees too much; losing dowel contact.

exercises.name: Ankle Knee-to-Wall Rocks
exercises.instructions: Face wall, drive knee toward wall while heel stays down.
exercises.common_errors: Heel lifting; knee collapsing inward; forcing pain.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Ankle Dorsiflexion Rock
exercises.instructions: Half-kneel and rock knee forward over toes while heel stays down.
exercises.common_errors: Arch collapsing; knee pain; heel lift.

exercises.name: Mini-Band Squat Hold
exercises.instructions: Hold shallow squat with band above knees, knees track over toes.
exercises.common_errors: Knees collapsing; feet rolling in; breath holding.

exercises.name: Mini-Band Lateral Walk
exercises.instructions: Step sideways with band tension, pelvis level and feet forward.
exercises.common_errors: Feet turning out; trunk swaying; knees collapsing.

exercises.name: Goblet Counterbalance Squat to Box
exercises.instructions: Hold light counterweight or arms forward, squat to box with control.
exercises.common_errors: Knees collapse; heels lift; trunk falling forward.

exercises.name: Wall Squat Facing Wall
exercises.instructions: Face wall, squat slowly without touching wall, keeping chest controlled.
exercises.common_errors: Too close; heel lift; knees collapse.

exercises.name: Tempo Squat to Box
exercises.instructions: Squat to box with three-second lowering, pause, stand tall.
exercises.common_errors: Dropping fast; knee collapse; breath holding.

exercises.name: Squat-to-Stand Mobility Drill
exercises.instructions: Reach toward toes, pull into squat, lift chest, then stand.
exercises.common_errors: Forcing low position; heels lifting; back pain.

exercises.name: Split Squat Short Range
exercises.instructions: Step into split stance and lower slightly with control.
exercises.common_errors: Front knee collapse; trunk lean; pain.

exercises.name: Controlled March with Pause
exercises.instructions: March slowly and pause at top of each knee lift while pelvis stays level.
exercises.common_errors: Leaning back; foot collapse; rushing.
